dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline following a high-degree falcate curvature along the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute apex with a small pixel radius and slight terminal structural erosion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High-steepness convex margin approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1:1.5 base-to-height ratio for the primary dorsal projection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple deep V-shaped and irregular notches along the trailing edge of the fin and the posterior dorsal ridge; numerous white punctate marks distributed across the lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced serrated appearance on the lower posterior margin of the visible dorsal ridge segment.
